api_sessions_app_scope.name: api_sessions_app_scope
api_sessions_app_scope.value: ('app' = ANY(scopes)) = (user_id IS NOT NULL AND device_id IS NOT NULL)

users_attested_at.name: users_attested_at
users_attested_at.value: NOT age_attested_18plus OR attested_at IS NOT NULL

users_wallet_required.name: users_wallet_required
users_wallet_required.value: is_demo OR deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR wallet_pubkey IS NOT NULL

rooms_expiry.name: rooms_expiry
rooms_expiry.value: expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= created_at + interval '14 days'

bets_stake_a_cap.name: bets_stake_a_cap
bets_stake_a_cap.value: stake_a IS NULL OR stake_a BETWEEN 1 AND 20000000

bets_stake_b_cap.name: bets_stake_b_cap
bets_stake_b_cap.value: stake_b IS NULL OR stake_b BETWEEN 1 AND 20000000

bets_binding_set.name: bets_binding_set
bets_binding_set.value:
state < 'AWAITING_AUTHORIZATIONS' OR state IN ('CANCELLED','EXPIRED')
        OR (terms_hash IS NOT NULL AND stake_a IS NOT NULL AND stake_b IS NOT NULL AND evidence_source IS NOT NULL)

bets_onchain_binding.name: bets_onchain_binding
bets_onchain_binding.value:
onchain_status = 'none'
        OR (terms_hash IS NOT NULL AND stake_a IS NOT NULL AND stake_b IS NOT NULL)

bets_wallet_snapshot.name: bets_wallet_snapshot
bets_wallet_snapshot.value: is_seed OR onchain_status = 'none' OR party_a_wallet IS NOT NULL

bets_auth_pairs.name: bets_auth_pairs
bets_auth_pairs.value:
(a_authorized_at IS NULL) = (a_authorization_method IS NULL)
        AND (b_authorized_at IS NULL) = (b_authorization_method IS NULL)

bets_locked_authorized.name: bets_locked_authorized
bets_locked_authorized.value:
is_seed OR onchain_status IN ('none','open','cancelled')
        OR (onchain_status = 'refunded' AND accept_sig IS NULL)
        OR (a_authorized_at IS NOT NULL AND b_authorized_at IS NOT NULL)

bets_refusal.name: bets_refusal
bets_refusal.value: (end_reason IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'refused') = (refusal_category IS NOT NULL)

bets_terminal_sig.name: bets_terminal_sig
bets_terminal_sig.value: is_seed OR onchain_status < 'settled' OR payout_sig IS NOT NULL

bets_payout_rule.name: bets_payout_rule
bets_payout_rule.value:
onchain_status < 'settled' OR (
        outcome IS NOT NULL AND payout_a IS NOT NULL AND payout_b IS NOT NULL
        AND CASE onchain_status
          WHEN 'cancelled' THEN payout_b = 0 AND payout_a >= stake_a
          WHEN 'refunded'  THEN (payout_b = 0 AND payout_a >= stake_a)
                             OR (payout_a = stake_a AND payout_b >= stake_b)
          ELSE payout_a + payout_b >= stake_a + stake_b AND CASE outcome
            WHEN 'party_a' THEN payout_b = 0
            WHEN 'party_b' THEN payout_a = 0
            WHEN 'refund'  THEN payout_a = stake_a
            WHEN 'split'   THEN payout_a = (payout_a + payout_b) / 2
          END
        END)

bets_odds_source.name: bets_odds_source
bets_odds_source.value: odds_source IS NULL OR odds_source IN ('mid','last_in_spread')

bets_odds_p_range.name: bets_odds_p_range
bets_odds_p_range.value: odds_p IS NULL OR odds_p BETWEEN 0 AND 1

bets_payout_nonneg.name: bets_payout_nonneg
bets_payout_nonneg.value: (payout_a IS NULL OR payout_a >= 0) AND (payout_b IS NULL OR payout_b >= 0)
